title: You Don't Need Motivation | A Discipline Short Film
lines: 6:00 a.m. He doesn't feel like it.
He never feels like it. That's not the point.
Motivation is a mood. Moods change by lunchtime.
Discipline is a decision you make before the mood arrives.
He doesn't wait to feel ready. He moves, and the feeling follows.
Because the fire will go out. The routine won't.
